_method: Joins over published data, no new counts. surahs: partners ranked by the sum over shared themes of the smaller per-1,000-word density (data/theme-surah-index.json), top 4, ties by surah number. themes: partners ranked by total verse-level co-occurrence between the two root families (data/cooccurrence/*.json, Leeds counts), top 3, ties by slug; via names the strongest single root pair. Root-to-theme grouping is editorial (themes.html); the counting is mechanical.
